name: notepadia-continuation-prompt
goal: Accomplish the macOS build inside the GitHub release workflow (unsigned, because there are no Apple Developer ID credentials), close every macOS packaging gap that does not require Apple credentials, and prep the signing/notarization path as a gated drop-in. Then fill the highest-value missing Notepad++ features.
rules: Before upgrading anything, inspect the official Eclipse Theia release page and current eclipse-theia/theia and eclipse-theia/theia-ide repositories.
Prefer the newest stable, mutually compatible Theia release available at generation time. Keep all @theia packages on one compatible release line.
Never introduce a random standalone monaco-editor version. Use Theia's Monaco integration.
Use the current Theia build pipeline. Do not add webpack if the current release is esbuild-only.
Use Theia services for editor, filesystem, navigator, workspace, commands, menus, keybindings, preferences and search.
Keep product-specific behavior in the Notepadia extension(s).
Use VS Code/Open VSX extensions for mature language support where compatible.
Do not implement language grammars from scratch unless no compatible extension exists.
Do not claim a build works unless it has actually been built and tested.
Preserve the existing repository's package manager and lockfile conventions when upgrading.
Improve the browser application first; use it for 99%+ of development and runtime. Touch the Electron target only when packaging distributables.
Keep react/react-dom as direct dependencies of the application packages; they are peer dependencies of @theia/core.
Do not reintroduce Yarn Berry artifacts (.pnp.cjs, .pnp.loader.mjs, .yarn/unplugged); the repository runs Yarn Classic with hoisted node_modules.
Avoid AI, debugger, SCM, remote development and notebook features unless explicitly requested or required for a Notepad++ feature.
Once complete with a milestone, commit it to GitHub prior to continuing
Use date-based product versions (YYYY.M.D, e.g. 2026.9.19) generated at build time by scripts/set-build-version.mjs (the repo stays 0.0.0), and tag releases vYYYY.M.D

auditSummary.conclusion: All milestones from v3/v5 are complete except M18 (macOS packaging and signing). Apple Developer ID credentials are NOT available, so the macOS build is accomplished UNSIGNED in the GitHub workflow, fully verified by CI (the 'M22' milestone below was implemented on 2026-09-19), and signing/notarization is prepared as a gated, configuration-only drop-in. The remaining not-milestone follow-ups are unit tests, a first published release (proving the updater flow), and the M23 missing-feature fill.

highValue.detail: Notepad++ headline feature: record a sequence of editing actions, stop, play back any number of times, optionally save/load. README.md already claims a 'Macros' menu but none is registered (verification: notepadia-menu-contribution.ts registers File/Edit/Search/View/Encoding/Language/Settings only). Monaco's UndoRedo stack does not expose macro recording directly; a macro would be captured as a command queue and replayed via monaco.editor.executeEdits or command execution.

Monaco already supports Alt+drag block selection; the gap is the 'Edit > Column Editor...' dialog (insert repeated text / sequential numbers down the selection). Implements via a quick-open/dialog that builds multi-cursor insertions.
Edit > Blank Operations: TAB to Space, Space to TAB, Trim leading and trailing, Trim trailing, EOL to space, Remove unnecessary EOL and trailing spaces. Only 'Trim Trailing Whitespace' exists today.

highValue.feature: Line operations: Split Lines and Remove Consecutive Duplicate Lines
highValue.detail: Split lines at a fixed wrap column / soft-wrap points; drop consecutive duplicates only (not all duplicates like the existing removeDuplicates).

highValue.feature: Search: Mark / Mark All with style, Select and Find Next, extended (escape) search mode
highValue.detail: Notepad++ marks occurrences with up to 5 style colors and can jump/extend selections. Monaco decorations can realize Mark All. Extended search mode treats \n, \t, \r literally without full regex.

mediumValue.detail: Notepad++ Run > Run... (F5) launches an external command with $(FULL_CURRENT_PATH) etc. Realize via Theia tasks or a small dialog spawning a process from Electron.
Monaco ships a minimap; expose it as View > Document Map toggle in the menu.
Notepad++ Window menu (tile up/down, cascade, window list). View > Document List partially covers the list already.
Insert special/box-drawing characters via an on-screen panel.
Electron webContents.print() / window.print(); Notepad++ File > Print.
Explicit Session Save/Load (session per project) on top of Theia's auto shell-layout restore.

outOfScopeOrLow: Full Notepad++ Preferences/Style Configurator dialog (Monaco theming limits)
Plugins/NppExec ecosystem (replaced by Theia's VS Code extension model per rules)
Full ~80-language catalog (curated 22 with Monarch tokenizers per rules)
Wildcard code-page breadth beyond Windows-1252 + ISO-8859 family

milestones.title: accomplish the macOS build in the GitHub release workflow (unsigned)
milestones.status: implemented - pending one CI verification run
milestones.blocker: NONE for the unsigned scope. Apple Developer ID credentials are not available; signing/notarization stays a gated optional path.
milestones.description: Make the macOS leg of release.yml complete and verifiable without any Apple credentials: produce and upload a correct, well-formed DMG + zip + latest-mac.yml every release; add macOS file associations; add artifact checksums; harden the config so code-signing/notarization activates automatically the day secrets exist; and verify the artifacts entirely from CI (no local Mac).
steps: 1. DONE electron-builder.yml mac block: hardenedRuntime: true, gatekeeperAssess: false, entitlements: build/entitlements.mac.plist, entitlementsInherit: build/entitlements.mac.inherit.plist, notarize: true (electron-builder skips notarization with a warning when the Apple env vars are absent), explicit artifactName 'Notepadia-${version}-${arch}.${ext}'.

2. DONE mac.fileAssociations mirroring the 22 extensions. electron-builder renders these as CFBundleDocumentTypes in Info.plist (it does NOT emit UTImportedTypeDeclarations; Finder association + role/rank/icon come from CFBundleDocumentTypes). Verified in node_modules/app-builder-lib/out/electron/electronMac.js.
3. DONE arch handling: macos-15 is an Apple-Silicon runner so artifacts are arm64; the ${arch} macro makes the name correct for whichever runner arch builds it. No forced arch.

4. DONE release.yml: global CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false removed; per-job env derives it as ${{ matrix.platform == 'macos' && secrets.CSC_LINK != '' }} and exports CSC_LINK/CSC_KEY_PASSWORD/APPLE_ID/APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD/APPLE_TEAM_ID from secrets (empty strings when unset = unchanged unsigned behavior).

5. DONE secret-gated signing block: none needed beyond the env above - electron-builder signs when CSC_LINK is set and notarizes when the APPLE_* vars are set; with none present it skips. Windows/Linux jobs stay unsigned.

6. DONE macOS artifact verification step (macos runner only): plutil -lint on Info.plist, convert to xml1 and assert all 22 CFBundleDocumentTypes extensions present, hdiutil imageinfo on the DMG; when signing secrets are set, additionally codesign --verify --deep --strict and spctl -a -vv --type execute.

7. DONE SHA-256 checksums: a Node step (uniform across win/linux/mac) writes <artifact>.sha256 for every exe/yml/blockmap/dmg/zip/AppImage/deb/rpm, uploads them to the draft release via gh release upload and includes them in the workflow artifact attachment glob.

8. DONE docs: docs/packaging.md (macOS signing/notarization/file associations + release integrity sections; arch-correct artifact table), docs/releases.md (macOS signing & notarization secrets checklist), CHANGELOG.md (macOS build in CI + Release integrity sections), README.md (Next milestones now points at notepadia_prompt_20260919.json; removed the incorrect 'Macros' menu claim).

9. PENDING (requires the repo owner to run it): trigger release.yml via workflow_dispatch and confirm the macos leg goes green and uploads DMG/zip/latest-mac.yml + .sha256 into the draft release with all three platform legs green.
10. DONE update this continuation file and commit (this commit).
acceptanceCriteria: A workflow_dispatch release run produces, on the macos-15 leg, an unsigned DMG + zip + latest-mac.yml + .sha256 files in the draft release, with all three platform legs green.
Mac artifact verification steps pass in CI (plist lint + all 22 extensions asserted + hdiutil imageinfo); codesign/spctl assertions are skipped when unsigned.
macOS .app bundle contains CFBundleDocumentTypes entries for the 22 associated file types.
With CSC_LINK etc. absent, the workflow does not attempt certificate discovery and never hangs or fails on signing.
docs/releases.md documents the exact secrets to add for a future signed/notarized release.
No workflow regression on Windows/Linux legs.
postSignedUpgradePath: Same workflow, no code change required apart from the user adding the five GitHub Secrets; the env block feeds electron-builder which signs + notarizes automatically.
The mac verification step then requires codesign --verify --deep --strict and spctl -a -vv unconditionally (already wired via the secrets.CSC_LINK guard).
Optional hardening: switch notarization to the APPLE_API_KEY / APPLE_API_KEY_ID / APPLE_API_ISSUER trio (electron-builder recommends it over app-specific password).

milestones.title: browser-only power-user features (sessions, escape search, character panel, print)
milestones.description: Next batch, all pure browser (no Electron-only code): (1) Named Sessions - File > Save Session... / Load Session... persist the open-file list (paths + active widget) to a workspace JSON file and restore the tabs on load; (2) Extended search mode - Search > Use Extended Search Mode toggle that treats \n, \t, \r, \\ literally for Mark / Mark All / Select and Find Next (pure escape->regex transform in src/common, unit-tested), closing the M23 deferral; (3) Character Panel - Edit > Character Panel toggles a dockable panel of common symbols/box-drawing/arrows/math inserts at the cursor; (4) Print - File > Print renders the active document to a print window and calls window.print(). New e2e suites: sessions, escape-search, character-panel, print. Unit tests for the escape-mode and session (de)serialization logic.
milestones.note: Explicitly browser-primary per repo rules; the Electron target stays untouched in this milestone.
